A '''mechno-chair''', also '''mechnochair''', was a type of self-propelled chair that moved on a set of four articulated legs, used primarily by wealthy [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] as a sign of their status. such as [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Mechno_chair.jpg|thumb|left|Side view of a mechno-chair]]
The devices, generally built by [[Affodies Crafthouse of Pure Neimoidia]], were prohibitively costly and were more of a status symbol than a mode of transportation. They featured two sickle-shaped rear legs that terminated in single-claw feet, and a pair of articulated double-clawed guidance limbs. Gyroscopically balanced, the chair's metallic surface was covered in etchings modeled after the shell ornamentation of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia's]] [[sovereign beetle]].  Mechno-chairs were primarily in use by Nemoidians prior to the Clone Wars and were seen as a symbol of grandeur and indulgence. They were noted as being uncomfortable to sit on. 

[[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] Gunray's own mechno-chair was fitted with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] encrypted to a secret channel maintained by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. This chair was made on the planet [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]] by the [[Xi Char/Legends|Xi Char]], and customized with a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] secret link and security systems that emitted toxic [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] gas. It also had a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]] that could be instructed to initiate remotely.

==History==
[[File:Mechnochair.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Nute Gunray and Darth Sidious using a mechno-chair]]
The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] communicated with Gunray via his mechno-chair during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], and later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|laid siege]] to his fortress on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], Gunray fled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but accidentally left his mechno-chair behind. Seized by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the mechno-chair, with its holo-recording of Sidious, provided the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with a valuable clue in the search for the elusive Sith Lord in the days prior to the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

After the reorganization of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], mechno-chairs were employed by Baron [[Merillion Tarko]], a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] ruling Cato Neimoidia.

Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several mechno-chairs were released to the public, some even being looted by various spacers. [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] and [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Warlock]] [[Cronal]] became so withered and shrunken from his immersion in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]], he required a special healing chamber to maintain him, which was carried by a Mechano-Chair provided by [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine]].
